blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Transport group Piston will hold a two-day nationwide strike next week to protest rising fuel prices, its national president Mody Floranda announced Tuesday. Speaking to reporters during a rally in Quezon City, Floranda said the strike would run from Sept. 29 to 30, coinciding with another expected increase in fuel prices. READ:
